title: KPT step 4: consonant clusters
summary: Learn changes where two neighbouring consonants act as one pattern.
objectives: Compare complete forms without adding a new ending decision.

sections.title: A cluster is a pair
paragraphs: A consonant cluster is two neighbouring consonants. Compare the whole pair instead of changing one isolated letter.
The five patterns in this block are shown explicitly.

sections.title: Look at the middle
paragraphs: The ending may come after the changed cluster, but the ending is not the target here.
Read the complete supplied forms and name only the cluster change.

steps: In the weak form it is ng.
Therefore the visible KPT change is nk → ng.
In the weak form it is ll.
Therefore the visible KPT change is lt → ll.
In the weak form it is nn.
Therefore the visible KPT change is nt → nn.

commonMistakes: Do not call the final -n part of the cluster.
Do not mix cluster patterns until each pair is familiar.

practiceExercises.prompt: What changes in kenkä (“shoe”) → kengän (“of the shoe”)?
practiceExercises.explanation: The whole cluster nk becomes ng.

optionFeedback.nk → ng: Correct. The whole cluster nk becomes ng.
optionFeedback.nt → nn: “nt → nn” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster nk becomes ng.
optionFeedback.kk → k: “kk → k” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster nk becomes ng.

practiceExercises.prompt: What changes in kampa (“comb”) → kamman (“of the comb”)?
practiceExercises.explanation: The whole cluster mp becomes mm.

optionFeedback.mp → mm: Correct. The whole cluster mp becomes mm.
optionFeedback.pp → p: “pp → p” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster mp becomes mm.
optionFeedback.nt → nn: “nt → nn” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster mp becomes mm.

practiceExercises.prompt: What changes in pelto (“field”) → pellon (“of the field”)?
practiceExercises.explanation: The whole cluster lt becomes ll.

optionFeedback.lt → ll: Correct. The whole cluster lt becomes ll.
optionFeedback.rt → rr: “rt → rr” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster lt becomes ll.
optionFeedback.tt → t: “tt → t” does not show the required pattern. The whole cluster lt becomes ll.

practiceExercises.prompt: Practice only: ranta (“beach”) → ____ (“of the beach”) · use supplied genitive -n; apply nt → nn
practiceExercises.explanation: The supplied target is the genitive meaning “of the beach”, so keep -n fixed. Change nt to nn and add -n: ranta → rannan.
